_comment: Anti-drift guard for the palisade: which piece and camera a wall hex draws (palisadeTiles.ts palisadeTileFor / Bjarnoy.Domain Palisades/PalisadeRules.TileFor), which placements are accepted or refused and why (canPlacePalisade / PalisadeRules.CanPlace) and which land ends are half open or sealed (classifyEnd / PalisadeRules.IsSealedEnd). Generated by scripts/regen-goldens/palisade-golden.ts from the frontend resolver; never hand-edit. wallNeighbours are in neighbors() direction order (E, NE, NW, W, SW, SE); dir is the art camera file (_E ... _SE); edges are direction indices. Terrain not listed is grass.

placementCases.name: first_hex_on_grass
placementCases.comment: An isolated wall hex is "not drawable yet", not an error.

placementCases.name: forest_is_allowed
placementCases.comment: Forest takes a wall.

placementCases.name: sand_is_allowed
placementCases.comment: Sand takes a wall.

placementCases.name: mountain_is_refused
placementCases.comment: No wall on a mountain.

placementCases.name: bog_is_refused
placementCases.comment: No wall on a bog.

placementCases.name: plain_bog_is_allowed
placementCases.comment: Plain bog moss takes a wall.

placementCases.name: bog_shore_is_refused
placementCases.comment: A bog shore, mouth or lake-side hex (bog that is not plain moss) takes none.

placementCases.name: bog_creek_is_refused
placementCases.comment: A creek is bog too, but not plain moss.

placementCases.name: wall_extends_over_plain_bog
placementCases.comment: A wall runs on from grass onto plain moss.

placementCases.name: lake_is_refused
placementCases.comment: No wall on a bog lake.

placementCases.name: river_hex_is_refused
placementCases.comment: No wall on any river tile, wide or not.

placementCases.name: open_sea_without_a_wall_is_refused
placementCases.comment: A sea hex only ever carries the sea end, hanging off exactly one land wall.

placementCases.name: occupied_hex_is_refused
placementCases.comment: A wall hex already stands there.

placementCases.name: extending_an_end_makes_a_straight
placementCases.comment: Two wall hexes in a line.

placementCases.name: closing_a_gap_makes_a_straight
placementCases.comment: Two arms with a hole between them.

placementCases.name: a_bend_is_allowed
placementCases.comment: A turn is fine for a plain wall.

placementCases.name: a_third_arm_is_a_branch
placementCases.comment: Three wall neighbours around the new hex.

placementCases.name: a_hex_next_to_a_straight_branches_it
placementCases.comment: The middle of a straight would get a third neighbour.

placementCases.name: gate_on_a_straight
placementCases.comment: A gate between two opposite wall hexes.

placementCases.name: gate_on_a_tight_bend_is_refused
placementCases.comment: Adjacent edges: bend60, no gate.

placementCases.name: gate_on_a_wide_bend_is_refused
placementCases.comment: One edge skipped: bend120, no gate.

placementCases.name: gate_with_no_neighbours_is_refused
placementCases.comment: A gate needs a straight.

placementCases.name: gate_at_a_wall_end_is_refused
placementCases.comment: One neighbour is an end, not a straight.

placementCases.name: gate_replaces_a_straight
placementCases.comment: Upgrading a standing straight into a gate.

placementCases.name: gate_on_water_is_refused
placementCases.comment: A gate is never a sea end.

placementCases.name: wall_next_to_a_gate_branches_it
placementCases.comment: A third neighbour for a gate.

placementCases.name: wall_that_turns_a_waiting_gate_is_refused
placementCases.comment: A gate with one neighbour so far must stay straight.

placementCases.name: wall_that_extends_a_waiting_gate_is_ok
placementCases.comment: The second neighbour opposite the first.

placementCases.name: sea_end_on_coastal_water
placementCases.comment: The sea end hangs off one land wall hex.

placementCases.name: sea_end_touching_two_walls_is_a_branch
placementCases.comment: A sea hex between two wall hexes.

placementCases.name: sea_end_without_a_wall_is_refused
placementCases.comment: Nothing to hang off.

placementCases.name: sea_end_off_a_sea_wall_is_refused
placementCases.comment: The only wall neighbour is itself on water.

placementCases.name: second_wall_next_to_a_sea_end_is_a_branch
placementCases.comment: A sea end takes exactly one land wall.

classifyEndCases.name: end_on_the_coast
classifyEndCases.comment: Sea beside the tip leaves it half open.

classifyEndCases.name: end_beside_a_wide_river
classifyEndCases.comment: A wide river neighbour seals it.

classifyEndCases.name: end_beside_a_lake
classifyEndCases.comment: A lake is not a barrier for this rule.
